name: ocean-procession
title: Ocean Procession
description: A fleet crosses a many-octave impossible sea: every hull bobs, pitches, rolls, and leaves a wake in a living field of reflected light.
controls: Move horizontally to orbit · Move vertically to dive and zoom
techniques: multi-octave directional waves · iterative heightfield intersection · analytic buoyancy · dynamic fleet and wakes · Fresnel reflection
